title: Milo's Rocket Launch
description: A short visual proof-of-concept: layered scenes, articulated character motion, rocket takeoff, particles and cinematic framing.

scenes.narration: Milo had one dream: build a rocket that could reach the stars.
After one last check, he hit the launch switch and watched it rise.
The rocket broke through the clouds. Milo knew this was only the beginning.
scenes.visual: THE SKY IS NOT THE LIMIT
